tagline: Scheduling and compliance automation for regulated trades.
summary: Micro-SaaS for small trade crews (1-20 people) who must file state compliance paperwork as part of their work. Captures client, property, and job data once and uses it to auto-populate required compliance forms, removing redundant manual re-entry.

positioning.differentiator: Compliance form automation is the core wedge, not an add-on feature. Scheduling exists to support compliance (know what job a form belongs to, who was on it) rather than to compete with full dispatch/field-service platforms.
positioning.market_gap: Existing septic-specific field service tools bundle compliance/permit tracking as one feature among many (scheduling, dispatch, route optimization, invoicing, fleet tracking). General field-service platforms (Jobber, ServiceTitan, FieldPulse) offer broad scheduling/CRM but no trade-specific compliance features. Cimitri's compliance-first, scheduling-as-infrastructure position is currently unclaimed.
positioning.explicit_non_competition: v1 deliberately avoids full live dispatch boards, GPS routing, and fleet/HR management to avoid competing head-on with incumbents' mature feature sets before the compliance wedge is validated.

target_market.not_targeting: 20-100+ personnel range served by incumbents like ServiceTitan

regulatory_context.form_full_name: Alabama Installer's Onsite Sewage Disposal System Certification
regulatory_context.issuing_body: Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH), onsite sewage division
regulatory_context.license_required: AOWB (Alabama Onsite Wastewater Board) license number
regulatory_context.submission_flow_confirmed: No reliable ADPH electronic filing portal for CEP-5. Form requires a signature and AOWB license number. Cimitri generates a filled PDF for print/wet-signature; Cimitri does not submit to ADPH or any authority.
regulatory_context.trade_licensing_note: CEP-5 applies specifically to AOWB-licensed septic installers. Alabama plumbers are licensed separately (Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board); general construction is not required to file CEP-5. Overlap happens at the individual/company level, not the form level.

staged_roadmap.description: Alabama septic installers. CEP-5 autofill + lightweight scheduling. Validates the core compliance-autofill wedge.
Add plumbing and construction verticals. Introduce their respective compliance forms as new templates within the same form-template engine. Validates that the architecture generalizes across trades.
Multi-state expansion, demand-dependent. Extend the same industries into other states once Alabama demand justifies it.

architecture_principle: Build the data model (customer/site/job core + swappable form templates) to be open-ended from day one, but do not build plumbing/construction/other-state templates until each prior stage is validated.
pricing_note: Pricing strategy is intentionally excluded from the PRD and lives in the separate strategy document.
